toolchain: CMake 4.4.2 with Visual Studio 17 2022, MSBuild 17.14.40, v143 MSVC, Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, C++20 Debug, and CTest 4.4.2.

transient_validation_retry.cause: The recorded child environment did not expose Get-FileHash. The retry used the repository Common.ps1 Get-FileSha256 helper; no source, binary, build, or test change was required.

behavior_proved: transport-neutral Manager startup definitions, statuses, mutation outcomes, and service operations validate coherent missing, disabled, ready, drifted, and foreign states
every startup service operation receives its expected definition plus bounded operation context, so a fresh process does not depend on cached launch state
canonical ownership, current-user SID syntax, least-privilege principal, immediate logon trigger, hidden-window executable action, restart policy, and launch-affecting settings are exact
native enablement is classified independently so an exact disabled registration remains Disabled instead of Drifted
unmistakably foreign ownership is classified before complete launch projection, while incomplete owned projection fails integrity validation
fixed durations and preserved non-fixed XSD duration text are mutually exclusive by construction
all modeled principal, trigger, action, action-context, and settings changes classify as owned drift, while each ownership-field change classifies as foreign
Task Scheduler native collection maxima remain repairable drift and each maximum-plus-one observation is rejected before policy acceptance
strict UTF-8, canonical low- and high-authority SID forms, Task Scheduler path bounds, and the combined Windows command-line ceiling are enforced
both new public headers are self-contained and the domain, contract, policy, and focused test targets compile with the required C++20 toolchain
two independent read-only reviews found no remaining P0, P1, or P2 issue after all reported findings were corrected

evidence_scope.proved: Source structure, layer integration, model invariants, exact normalized policy classification, bounded-input behavior, public-header containment, and focused native tests on this Windows 11 development machine.
evidence_scope.not_proved: COM Task Scheduler connection, real task registration or mutation, concrete worker cancellation and shutdown, watchdog recovery, packaged UI automation, or the authoritative G16 gate.

remaining_limitations: P16 remains in progress and G16 remains not started.
The concrete Windows Task Scheduler adapter, dedicated bounded COM worker, post-mutation reinspection, and real-machine task lifecycle test remain pending.
The Manager watchdog, production composition and operational services, terminal named-pipe quiescence, live Edge dashboard behavior, and native UI automation remain pending.
